message.content: {"verdict": "compliant", "citations": ["rbi-13157", "rbi-12825", "rbi-12125"], "evidence": [{"doc_id": "rbi-13157", "quote": "If a Term Deposit (TD) matures and proceeds are unpaid, the amount left unclaimed with a bank, shall attract rate of interest as applicable to savings account or the contracted rate of interest on the matured TD, whichever is lower."}, {"doc_id": "rbi-12825", "quote": "If a Term Deposit (TD) matures and proceeds are unpaid, the amount left unclaimed with the bank, shall attract rate of interest as applicable to savings account or the contracted rate of interest on the matured TD, whichever is lower."}], "confidence": 1.0, "rationale": "The clause accurately reflects the mandatory requirement in the RBI Directions that unclaimed proceeds of a matured term deposit must earn interest at the lower of the savings account rate or the contracted rate on the matured deposit."}
